verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies an app distribution channel. Teams documents publishing agents and apps 'in Teams' (docs-7), and configuring teams with apps via Microsoft Graph (docs-35/43). Neither snippet shows a browsable app directory or store, or a team-admin flow for installing prebuilt third-party integrations. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Teams app store/directory, an admin-facing install flow for prebuilt integrations, catalog breadth, admin approval/governance controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
